tickets.subject: Password reset email not received
tickets.description: User requests password reset but email is not delivered. Spam folder checked; no reset email arrives.
tickets.resolution_notes: Confirmed the account email address, corrected a stale email alias, and resent the reset link. User confirmed receipt.

tickets.subject: Users cannot sign in after SSO configuration change
tickets.description: Several users receive an authentication error after an identity provider setting was changed.
tickets.resolution_notes: Reverted the incorrect SSO callback URL and validated login with the affected users.

tickets.subject: Revenue dashboard chart is blank
tickets.description: Revenue tab loads but the chart area is empty with no visible error. Other dashboard tabs load.
tickets.resolution_notes: Found a date filter outside the available data range. Reset the date range and refreshed the dashboard cache.

tickets.subject: Dashboard visualization missing after filter update
tickets.description: A bar chart disappears after a user selects a restrictive filter combination.
tickets.resolution_notes: Cleared the incompatible filter and restored the default date range. Added a note explaining supported filter combinations.

tickets.subject: Duplicate subscription charge on monthly invoice
tickets.description: Customer's payment statement shows two subscription charges for the same billing period.
tickets.resolution_notes: Payment processor showed one settled charge and one authorization. The authorization expired; confirmed no second capture occurred.

tickets.subject: Customer billed twice after retry
tickets.description: A payment retry appears to have created duplicate monthly subscription payments.
tickets.resolution_notes: Matched processor transaction IDs, voided the duplicate captured payment, and verified the ledger. Escalated the idempotency defect to engineering.

tickets.subject: Scheduled report arrives late
tickets.description: A scheduled analytics report was delivered several hours after its configured delivery time.
tickets.resolution_notes: Checked the job queue and found a temporary backlog. Reprocessed the failed job and monitored the next scheduled run.

tickets.subject: CSV export fails for large reports
tickets.description: Exporting a large analytics report fails before the download begins.
tickets.resolution_notes: Reduced the selected date range to confirm a row-limit issue and recommended asynchronous export. Logged a product issue for clearer error messaging.

tickets.subject: Dashboard data appears stale
tickets.description: Charts show yesterday's figures even though the source data has been updated.
tickets.resolution_notes: Verified the ingestion job completed, invalidated the dashboard cache, and confirmed the latest figures appeared.

tickets.subject: API token rejected by reporting endpoint
tickets.description: Requests to the reporting API return unauthorized after an API token was rotated.
tickets.resolution_notes: Updated the stored token in the integration settings and verified the request with a least-privilege service account.

tickets.subject: Webhook delivery retries repeatedly
tickets.description: Webhook notifications are retried because the receiver returns intermittent 5xx responses.
tickets.resolution_notes: Confirmed receiver errors from delivery logs, coordinated with the receiver owner, and replayed failed events after recovery.

tickets.subject: Unable to invite a new team member
tickets.description: Admin receives an error when inviting another user to the workspace.
tickets.resolution_notes: The workspace had reached its seat limit. Adjusted the subscription after customer approval and resent the invitation.
